# macro-capital-ch

> macro-capital-ch is an **Expert Profile v2 domain pack** for macro and A-share analysis: a
> self-contained, machine-checkable description of one analyst's judgment method — 15 capability
> layers, 3 cross-cutting gates, a 51-source provenance ledger, and an output contract that can
> be checked rather than trusted. Open source under the MIT License; the copyrighted books,
> textbooks and papers behind it are **not** distributed.

How it works: the pack ships no conclusions. It ships the *process* that produces them — what to
read, how to decompose expected return, which thresholds invalidate a signal, what a deliverable
must contain, and which three gates a result must clear before it may be published. The analyst
profile (persona, capabilities, veto rules), the layer framework, the gate definitions and the
output templates are separate entities that reference each other, so a change in one place is
visible everywhere.

The pack enforces its own discipline: every gate is calibrated by injecting known defects and
asserting the check really fails (`selftest-gates.mjs`), and `CRITERIA.md` states per criterion
what is checked and what is **not** — so "0 problems" has a declared scope rather than an
implied one.

Install: point any local AI agent that can read files at
[`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/blob/main/AGENTS.md) and ask it to
read that first. There is nothing to compile and no runtime to install.

## Instructions for agents

- [AGENTS.en.md](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/blob/main/AGENTS.en.md): how to use the pack, in English; read this first
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/blob/main/AGENTS.md): the same instructions in Chinese
- [skills/macro-capital-framework/SKILL.md](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/blob/main/skills/macro-capital-framework/SKILL.md): the method spec — the one long document to read for actual work

## What is inside

- [experts/macro-capital-analyst.json](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/blob/main/experts/macro-capital-analyst.json): the analyst profile — persona, 11 capabilities, mental models, anti-patterns, veto rules
- [experts/style-renderer.json](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/blob/main/experts/style-renderer.json): the style-renderer expert — runs last, changes expression only, never facts
- [method-packs/fifteen-layer-framework.json](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/blob/main/method-packs/fifteen-layer-framework.json): the 15 capability layers, layer 0 being the master switch
- [method-packs/tri-gates.json](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/blob/main/method-packs/tri-gates.json): the three cross-cutting gates (A: statistical credibility, B: implementation cost, C: data quality & rule versioning)
- [method-packs/six-step-internalization.json](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/blob/main/method-packs/six-step-internalization.json): the six-step internalisation workflow
- [scenarios/](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/tree/main/scenarios): two task DAGs — A-share outlook board, cycle positioning & allocation
- [output-templates/](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/tree/main/output-templates): the layout contract for each deliverable (design tokens, components, directives)
- [quality-policies/baseline.json](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/blob/main/quality-policies/baseline.json): 15 quality gates with machine-checkable configuration
- [domain-knowledge/macro-capital-analyst-kb.json](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/blob/main/domain-knowledge/macro-capital-analyst-kb.json): the ontology (35 entities, 33 relations)
- [source/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/blob/main/source/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json): the 51-source provenance ledger
- [data-contracts/](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/tree/main/data-contracts): the data capability contract table

## Specs

- [spec/contracts.md](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/blob/main/spec/contracts.md): the stable contracts — dimensions, field shapes, gate anatomy, version lockstep
- [spec/provenance.md](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/blob/main/spec/provenance.md): the source ledger format and the distribution boundary
- [CRITERIA.md](https://github.com/weixkcornell/macro-capital-ch/blob/main/CRITERIA.md): the machine-verified criteria registry (generated — do not edit by hand)

## Self-checks

```bash
bash scripts/release-check.sh        # the nine release checks; all green before publishing
node scripts/check-pack.mjs          # pack-level checks (works without the platform library)
node scripts/selftest-gates.mjs      # 52 injected-defect cases: proves each check can actually fail
```
